description: This Java class 'WebAppCache' manages caching of web application information retrieved from component configurations in the OFBiz framework. It provides methods to retrieve web app info based on server name and menu, and maintains an internal cache to improve performance.

classes.name: WebAppCache
classes.description: A cache for storing web application information to optimize retrieval and reduce repeated component configuration access.

methods.name: WebAppCache
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the cache with a supplier for component configurations.

methods.name: getAppBarWebInfos
methods.description: Retrieves web application info visible for a specific server, optionally filtered by menu name.

methods.name: getWebappInfo
methods.description: Finds the first web application info matching a specific web app name for a given server.

methods.name: getShared
methods.description: Returns a singleton shared instance of the WebAppCache.
